fields.summary_ko.0: MediaTek (TW0002454006) achieved record quarterly revenue of TWD 168.06 billion in Q3 (up 10.43% quarter-over-quarter, up 1.97% year-over-year).
fields.summary_ko.1: Following NVIDIA's $3.5 billion convertible bond investment (August 31) and first data center AI accelerator mass production planned for Q4 2026, AI infrastructure strategy is progressing, with data center revenue projected to exceed $2 billion annually.
